title: Lesson 46 option-two relational nounstems technical proof

groups.title: Option-two integrated-matrix system
groups.proposal: Build option-two relational NNCs from one typed embedded nounstem plus its licensed relational matrix and boundary.
groups.readingJob: Show embedded Source, relational matrix, source class, state, and boundary realization.
groups.decisionSplit: Only Source kinds licensed by the selected relational family are available.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not treat relational matrices as detachable suffixes or prepositions.

groups.title: Locative n source formations
groups.proposal: Feed locative n with exact ordinary, preterit-agentive, active-action, interrogative, or modified Source Results and preserve supportive-i and participant mapping.
groups.readingJob: Show upstream Source owner, formation, participant transfer, matrix attachment, and supportive-i boundary.
groups.decisionSplit: Source formation is selected only among owner-issued alternatives licensed for locative n.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not reconstruct a preterit-agentive or active-action Source from its written stem.

groups.title: Locative n predicate voice and state
groups.proposal: Derive absolutive or possessive locative state from exact imperfect active, passive, impersonal, incorporated-adverb, or yohua Source Results.
groups.readingJob: Show Source voice, participant mode, incorporated adverb, resulting state, and possessor mapping.
groups.decisionSplit: Voice and formation remain upstream choices; locative state is derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not expose derived state as an independent correction control.

groups.title: yan perfective locatives
groups.proposal: Build yan locatives only from exact perfective or incorporated-perfective Sources, mapping subject to possessor unless the impersonal or incorporated branch requires absolutive state.
groups.readingJob: Show perfective Source, incorporated or impersonal branch, subject-to-possessor mapping, and resulting state.
groups.decisionSplit: The upstream perfective formation is the genuine choice; state follows canonically.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not infer a perfective Source from a surface ending.

groups.title: tlah abundance-place formations
groups.proposal: Compose tlah with licensed ordinary or varietal nounstem Sources and preserve its absolutive or possessive state and affective continuation.
groups.readingJob: Show Source variety, abundance-place relation, state, affective availability, and boundary.
groups.decisionSplit: Source variety and state are available only where the owner licenses them.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not generalize tlah from translation or surface resemblance.

groups.title: co or c specific-location boundary
groups.proposal: Choose co or c from the typed Source edge, including the fire exception, temporal-yo nesting, body-part Sources, and affective silent replacement.
groups.readingJob: Show Source edge, selected matrix variant, lexical exception, nested Source history, and affective replacement.
groups.decisionSplit: Only a genuine lexical exception is selectable; ordinary co/c realization is automatic.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not select co or c from spelling after generation.

groups.title: Body-part specific-location combinations
groups.proposal: Preserve body-part nounstem identity inside co/c location formations, including state, participant, compound, and contextual reading distinctions.
groups.readingJob: Show body-part Source, internal state, participant structure, matrix boundary, and contextual location reading.
groups.decisionSplit: Only typed Source and state facts are choices; the location reading remains descriptive.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not classify these combinations as compound prepositions.

groups.title: ca interval and pa direction or frequency
groups.proposal: Separate ca interval from locative c and separate pa direction from pa frequency by typed Source kind, allowing nested relational and can compounds only on licensed paths.
groups.readingJob: Show Source kind, relational function, nested source, frequency homonym gate, and boundary assimilation.
groups.decisionSplit: Direction, frequency, and interval follow the selected typed Source family.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not disambiguate homonyms from translated meaning alone.

groups.title: nal, chi, ic, and teuh matrix restrictions
groups.proposal: Enforce fixed water, favored ground, body-part, rare nounstem, and similarity Source restrictions for nal, chi, ic, and teuh.
groups.readingJob: Show fixed or preferred Source, exceptional alternative, relational function, and rejected Source kinds.
groups.decisionSplit: An alternative Source is selectable only when the matrix owner licenses it.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not generalize from the productivity of another option-two family.

groups.title: Numeral-modified co/c locations
groups.proposal: Require the numeral modifier to enter through its typed adverbial form before combining with a co/c location Source.
groups.readingJob: Show numeral Source, adverbialization, modified location Source, and non-authoritative contextual translation.
groups.decisionSplit: Numeral and location Sources are genuine choices; adverbialization is derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not attach a raw numeral or authorize morphology from the translation.
